name: add_goal
title: Add a goal
description: Adds a goal to a participant, at the end of their active goals. Returns its goalId and the expectedVersion that a later change needs. An archived participant's goals cannot be changed: restore the participant first. The result's helpText says what a change to a goal does to notes.

participantId.description: The participantId that find_participants or get_participant returned.

text.description: The goal's wording: at most 200 characters, on one line.

name: add_participant
title: Add a participant
description: Adds an active participant to this organisation. Returns their participantId and the expectedVersion that a later change needs. Never returns a date of birth.

givenName.description: The given name: at most 100 characters.

familyName.description: The family name: at most 100 characters.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth, written YYYY-MM-DD and before today.

name: archive_goal
title: Archive a goal
description: Archives a goal, which acts at once. Needs the goalId and expectedVersion that get_participant returned. An archived goal answers changed: false. The result has no version: look the goal up again with get_participant before the next change. A goal of an archived participant cannot be changed: restore the participant first. The result's helpText says what a change to a goal does to notes.

expectedVersion.description: The expectedVersion that get_participant returned for this goal.

name: find_participants
title: Find participants by name
description: Finds participants of this organisation by name. Every word of search must appear in the given or family name; case is ignored. Returns at most 10, sorted by family name then given name, each with its status (active or archived); archived participants only with includeArchived. If two people have the same name, or you are not sure which one the person means, ask them. Never returns a date of birth or anything about notes.

search.description: Part of the participant's name: at least 2 characters and at most 100. Each word must appear in the given or family name.

name: get_participant
title: Get a participant and their goals
description: One participant of this organisation with their goals: active goals in their order, then archived goals. Use a participantId from find_participants. A later change to the participant or a goal needs its expectedVersion. Never returns a date of birth or anything about notes.

annotations.title: Get a participant and their goals

name: reorder_goals
title: Reorder a participant's goals
description: Puts a participant's active goals in a new order. goalIds must hold every active goal of the participant exactly once, in the order wanted; an archived goal is not one of them. Needs no expectedVersion. An order that is already stored answers changed: false. Returns the goals as get_participant lists them, every expectedVersion current. An archived participant's goals cannot be changed: restore the participant first. The result's helpText says what a change to a goal does to notes.

participantId.description: The participantId that find_participants or get_participant returned.

goalIds.description: The goalId of every active goal of the participant, once each, in the new order.

name: restore_goal
title: Restore a goal
description: Restores an archived goal, which acts at once, and puts it at the end of the participant's active goals. Needs the goalId and expectedVersion that get_participant returned. An active goal answers changed: false. The result has no version: look the goal up again with get_participant before the next change. A goal of an archived participant cannot be changed: restore the participant first. The result's helpText says what a change to a goal does to notes.

expectedVersion.description: The expectedVersion that get_participant returned for this goal.

name: update_goal
title: Reword a goal
description: Rewords a goal. Needs the goalId and expectedVersion that get_participant returned. A call that would change nothing answers changed: false. A goal of an archived participant cannot be changed: restore the participant first. The result's helpText says what a change to a goal does to notes.

text.description: The new wording: at most 200 characters, on one line.

expectedVersion.description: The expectedVersion that get_participant returned for this goal.

name: update_participant
title: Correct a participant's name or date of birth
description: Corrects a participant's given name, family name or date of birth: send only the fields to change. Needs the participantId and expectedVersion that get_participant returned. A call that would change nothing answers changed: false. An archived participant cannot be changed: restore the participant first. Never returns a date of birth.

participantId.description: The participantId that find_participants or get_participant returned.

expectedVersion.description: The expectedVersion that get_participant returned for this participant.

givenName.description: The new given name: at most 100 characters.

familyName.description: The new family name: at most 100 characters.

dateOfBirth.description: The new date of birth, written YYYY-MM-DD and before today.

annotations.title: Correct a participant's name or date of birth
